description: This file defines a UsersController class that handles API requests related to user profiles in an ASP.NET Core Web API. It provides endpoints for retrieving the current user's profile and listing all users, utilizing dependency-injected user service.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: API controller for user-related endpoints, secured with authorization, providing methods to retrieve current user profile and list all users.

methods.name: Me
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user based on claims.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.
